scope: Exploratory qualitative reflex and physical support calibration; not a fit to biological recordings.

protocol.source_snapshot_timing: Assembled after the exploratory runs. Maintained fit_calibration.py archives code before future runs.

execution.note: Experimental FP16 state, weights and arithmetic; rounding changes firing and is not reference-equivalent. All neurons, edges and ticks retained. Coarse neural clock: delays and refractory durations round up; spike timing and behavior change.

metrics.interpretation: Swing candidates require unload, clearance and displaced landing; these thresholds are engineering diagnostics, not biological gait validation. Loaded-foot travel includes contact deformation and sliding.
